entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still, this is a surprise... All the cognitive[n]guests in this Palace seem like real[n]humans.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The casino earlier looked pretty real too,[n]but talking with these guests was a whole[n]'nother story.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You have that right...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This ruler's observational skills and insight[n]are off the charts. Shido's a formidable[n]foe...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, no need to freak out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm not freaking out! I was just thinking[n]it'll be easier to make a plan since they[n]can talk normally.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's put together the[n]information we gathered.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...So, we gotta get a "letter of[n]introduction" from the five VIPs?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And those letters become the keycards?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Exactly. Now, let's go over what all of us[n]have learned.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: First, according to my intel...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: One of the VIPs is an influential politician[n]by the name of Ooe.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He's supposedly seen at the restaurant at[n]night and sits at a table near the window.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um, I'll go next. I heard about a[n]prominent VIP who used to be...[n]nobility?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They said he's usually by the pool.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Next is my intelligence. It seems the[n]president of a television station is also[n]a VIP.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He always plays slots at night. It would[n]seem he spends his money quite lavishly.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Crap, I'm startin' to forget people already...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Next is my turn!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real!? Even you got info?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Of course. I eavesdropped.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Supposedly one of the VIPs is the[n]president of an IT company.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He's always in his room and reportedly[n]enters from an exclusive hallway.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well then, I'll close us out!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How the hell'd you get info with[n]your looks?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It seems like some guy they call the[n]"cleaner" is another VIP.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've heard that he's cautious, so it's[n]probably best if we check the other[n]VIPs first.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Cleaner? I wonder what they mean by that.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait a minute. After all the VIPs we listed,[n]this one's a cleaner?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is he really a VIP?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Supposedly.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry... I couldn't get any information.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Me neither! So don't worry about it,[n]okay? Let's just work harder during[n]the battle.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You're right... I'll do my best!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But there's a bigger problem, y'know...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: My memory's, uh... not so great.[n]Anyways, who was who...? Uhhh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, it's no use! I can't keep the profiles[n]of five people straight in my head...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can only remember about two of them...[n]What about you, Joker?
My memory is pristine.
I'm bad at remembering...
I forgot all of them.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Really!? Wow!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Right!? I totally get you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh dear lord...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We're up against five people.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The politician Ooe, a former noble,[n]a TV station president, an IT company[n]president, and a cleaner.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We get certification from them and[n]obtain letters of introduction that'll[n]serve as keycards.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But only go for the cleaner after the other[n]four have been dealt with. Right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Whoa! Now that's impressive![n]You go, genius!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we can't remember the details on the[n]VIPs, let's reconvene inside a safe room.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's get this done quickly!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We know how to get into the main[n]assembly hall now... Should we head[n]home?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? You wanna go back already?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There are people in here with special[n]letters. That means Shido trusts them[n]to a certain extent.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It would be best to consider them[n]as powerful individuals...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We do not want to get too hasty.[n]Let us take our time here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess we do have a little time to spare.[n]Well then, let's head back for today.
